maddeler.e:
تكافرت (form VI)
# تَكَافَرْتُ (takāfartu) /ta.kaː.far.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَكَافَرَ (takāfara)
# تَكَافَرْتَ (takāfarta) /ta.kaː.far.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَكَافَرَ (takāfara)
# تَكَافَرْتِ (takāfarti) /ta.kaː.far.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَكَافَرَ (takāfara)
# تَكَافَرَتْ (takāfarat) /ta.kaː.fa.rat/: third-person fem
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
